text: Here's how you can record the screen on your iPhone.
And hit the green plus button beside it.
Now, swipe down from the top left corner to open Control Center, and hit the record button.
You'll see a countdown, and when the button turns red, you're recording your screen.
When you're done, open Control Center again, and hit the record button to stop recording.
You can find your screen recording in the Followers app.
From here, you can hit the share button and send it to your grandma to show her how to use her phone.
